departments.description: The Eye Department at Palamu Neuro & Eye Care leads in eye care, offering advanced diagnostics and personalized treatment plans for various conditions. Our experienced ophthalmologists, led by Dr. Dibya Prabha, specialize in managing complex disorders such as retinal diseases, cataracts, glaucoma, and eye tumors. Serving Palamu, Jharkhand, and beyond, we are dedicated to excellence in eye care. Our services include:

services.name: Retinal Injection
services.details: Injecting medications directly into the retina to treat conditions like macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy.

services.name: Retinal Laser
services.details: Using laser technology to treat retinal conditions such as diabetic retinopathy and retinal tears.

services.name: Complex Retinal Surgery
services.details: Advanced surgical techniques to repair complex retinal conditions like retinal detachment and macular holes.

services.name: Cataract Surgery
services.details: State-of-the-art cataract removal and lens replacement surgery to restore clear vision.

services.name: Fundus Photograph
services.details: High-resolution imaging of the retina to diagnose and monitor eye conditions.

services.name: OCT (Optical Coherence Tomography)
services.details: Non-invasive imaging for detailed retina and optic nerve analysis.

services.name: OCTA (Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography)
services.details: Advanced imaging to visualize blood flow in the retina and choroid.
benefits: Early detection of vascular eye diseases

privacy.metaDescription: Learn how Palamu Neuro & Eye Care collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
body: Welcome to Palamu Neuro & Eye Care! This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our services. By engaging with Palamu Neuro & Eye Care, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
body: We may collect the following types of information:
Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, and other details you provide when booking an appointment or using our services.
Medical Information: Health history, symptoms, and treatment details relevant to your care.
Usage Data: Information about how you interact with our website, such as pages visited and time spent.
Cookies and Tracking: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience and analyze website usage.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
body: We use your information for the following purposes:
To provide, maintain, and improve our medical services.
To communicate with you about appointments, follow-ups, and health updates.
To personalize your experience and provide relevant health information.
To comply with legal obligations and protect patient rights.

sections.heading: 4. Data Sharing and Disclosure
body: We do not sell your personal information. However, we may share it in the following cases:
Medical Professionals: With doctors and specialists involved in your care.
Legal Requirements: When required by law or to protect patient safety.
Service Providers: With third-party vendors who assist in operating our clinic (e.g., IT support, billing).

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
body: We take reasonable measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. All medical records are stored securely and accessed only by authorized personnel.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
body: You have the following rights regarding your data:
Access and update your personal information.
Request deletion of your data, subject to legal and medical retention requirements.
Opt-out of non-essential communications.
Withdraw consent for data processing, where applicable.
To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@palamu-neuro-care.app.

sections.heading: 7. Third-Party Links
body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for their privacy practices. Please review their policies before providing any information.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting the new policy on our website or sending you an email.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Us
body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
hello@palamu-neuro-care.app
Address: Sitakunj police line road, Hamidganj, Medininagar, Jharkhand 822102

faq.title: Got Questions?
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services, appointments, and more.

questions.question: What conditions do you treat at Palamu Neuro & Eye Care?
questions.answer: At Palamu Neuro & Eye Care in Palamu, we specialize in neurology and ophthalmology, treating conditions such as migraines, epilepsy, stroke, Parkinson's disease, cataracts, glaucoma, and retinal disorders. Our team of experts provides comprehensive care for patients from Jharkhand, Bihar, West Bengal, and Chhattisgarh.

questions.question: How do I book an appointment?
questions.answer: You can book an appointment by clicking the 'Book an Appointment' button on our website or calling us directly at 7779897207. We also offer online scheduling for your convenience.

questions.question: Do you offer video consultations?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer video consultations for patients who cannot visit the clinic in person. This service is ideal for follow-ups, second opinions, and non-emergency consultations, especially for patients traveling from Bihar, West Bengal, or Chhattisgarh.

questions.question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
questions.answer: Please bring your ID, medical records, any previous test results, and a list of current medications. If you have insurance, bring your insurance card as well. For patients traveling from other states, we recommend carrying all relevant medical documents.

questions.question: What are your clinic hours?
questions.answer: Doctor consultations are available strictly on Sundays. However, our pharmacy and appointment booking services are open 7 days a week.

questions.question: How do I reach Palamu Neuro & Eye Care from the railway station or airport?
questions.answer: Our clinic is conveniently located in Medininagar and is easily accessible from the railway station and airport. You can take a taxi or auto-rickshaw. Our address: Sitakunj police line road, Hamidganj, Medininagar. You can call us at 7779897207.
